title: Challenge content is readable while a stage is armed before its actual start time

original_titles.title: Challenge content readable before the round window opens (no pre-delivery, no starts_at check)
No encrypted per-participant bundle pre-delivery or timed key release (LB-04a S1, LB-04b, CH-10a)
No per-participant sealed bundles or T0 key release
No encrypted bundle pre-fetch or key release; materials served in plaintext at armed

problem: The legacy challenge release helper permits armed stages and does not compare the database clock with starts_at. The four-level repository read path checks live event, team assignment and level pointer but does not consistently enforce the stage start-time gate before serving file bytes.
impact: Participants can pre-download/read source before T0. Early-locking teams can gain more effective work time and hidden content may leak ahead of the event start.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create one shared content_gate(session, event_id, stage_id, user_id, now_db) function and call it from every route that returns challenge names, tree metadata, search results, file content, repo archive, guide content or uploads.
Read clock_timestamp() from PostgreSQL in the same transaction that reads stage state. Require status active or an explicitly owner-approved paused/readable state and require now >= starts_at.
For levels, require the participant pointer node and the team gate to allow execution before returning repository bytes. Do not rely only on UI route guards.
Set starts_at when arming or use a separate scheduled start; make null starts_at a closed gate, not an open gate.
Add boundary tests at starts_at - 1ms, exact starts_at, paused, ended and future pointer; assert all content routes return no bytes before the gate opens.

acceptance_criteria: No source bytes/search results/tree metadata that reveal challenge content are returned before T0.
All legacy and four-level content routes call the same server-side gate.
Gate uses DB time, not browser time.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
